Staff Report Printout
C. Request of Councilmember de la Torre that the City Council allocate $5000 from its discretionary funds to the Association of Mexican American Educators in support of the Samohi Latino Graduation, organized by student group Legado Latino. These funds will assist in covering event expenses such as stoles, medals, diplomas, food and drinks, and entertainment. This event offers students a chance to celebrate their accomplishments and showcase their vibrant cultural heritage to the local community.

  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  APRIL 23, 2024

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Brock at 5:43 p.m., on
  Tuesday, April 23, 2024, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA and Hyatt House
  Tempe Hotel, 601 E. 6th Street, Tempe, Arizona 85281

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Phil Brock
  Mayor Pro Tem Lana Negrete
  Councilmember Oscar de la Torre (via telephone)
  Councilmember Christine Parra
  Councilmember Caroline Torosis
  Councilmember Jesse Zwick

  Absent:  Councilmember Gleam Davis

  Also Present:  City Manager David White
  City Attorney Douglas Sloan
  Interim City Clerk Nikima S. Newsome

  CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 5:43 p.m., with all
  members present except Councilmember Davis. Councilmember Zwick led
  the assemblage in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  LEVINE ACT  Pursuant to the Levine Act (Govt Code Section 84308), any party to a
  DISCLOSURE  permit, license, contract, or other entitlement before the Council is
  required to disclose on the record any contribution, including
  aggregated contributions, of more than $250 made by the party or the
  party's agents within the preceding 12 months to any City official.
  Participants and agents are requested to make this disclosure as well.
  The disclosure must include the name of the party, participant, or
  agent, and any other person making the contribution; the name of the
  recipient, the amount of the contribution, and the date the contribution
  was made.

  presentation (3.D.) first, followed by Bob’s Market Commendation (3.C.)
  and public comment from Santa Monica High School students regarding
  Councilmember Discussion item (16.C.)
